# FG-WEB-0005

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `readyz_probe_is_bounded_by_its_timeout` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: サーバーの準備ができていません。しばらくしてから再度お試しください。
- en: The server is not ready. Try again later.
- id: Server belum siap. Coba lagi nanti.

## 原因 (cause)

A readiness probe (GET /readyz) did not answer within its client-side timeout, so the dependency it checks (named by `probe`, e.g. database) is treated as unavailable.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `probe` and `timeout_ms`. Run `forge doctor` on the host to check the same dependency without the HTTP path; for the database see the db-unavailable runbook (a half-open connection or an overloaded server does not answer).

## 対処 (fix)

Restore the dependency named by `probe`; if it is healthy but slow, look at its load. The readiness timeout is deliberately short so load balancers stop routing to a stuck instance.
